echo '== imports'; I=$(go list -e -overlay $P/overlay.json -f '{{join .Imports " "}}' ./supervisor) || exit 1; for i in $I; do case $i in errors|fmt|strconv|strings|time|morphstudio/queue|morphstudio/gitrules|morphstudio/control|morphstudio/stream) ;; *) echo "imports: package supervisor imports $i (allowed: errors, fmt, strconv, strings, time, morphstudio/queue, morphstudio/gitrules, morphstudio/control, morphstudio/stream)"; exit 1;; esac; done
echo '== clock'; C=$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Now -> time.Time' supervisor/loop.go 2>&1)$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Since -> time.Time' supervisor/loop.go 2>&1); [ -z "$C" ] || { echo "clock: supervisor/loop.go reads time.Now or time.Since (the clock is the now argument)"; exit 1; }

echo '== imports'; I=$(go list -e -overlay $P/overlay.json -f '{{join .Imports " "}}' ./supervisor) || exit 1; for i in $I; do case $i in errors|fmt|strconv|strings|time|morphstudio/queue|morphstudio/gitrules|morphstudio/control|morphstudio/stream) ;; *) echo "imports: package supervisor imports $i (allowed: errors, fmt, strconv, strings, time, morphstudio/queue, morphstudio/gitrules, morphstudio/control, morphstudio/stream)"; exit 1;; esac; done
echo '== clock'; C=$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Now -> time.Time' supervisor/guard.go 2>&1)$(gofmt -l -r 'time.Since -> time.Time' supervisor/guard.go 2>&1); [ -z "$C" ] || { echo "clock: supervisor/guard.go reads time.Now or time.Since (the clock is the now argument)"; exit 1; }

echo '== imports'; I=$(go list -e -overlay $P/overlay.json -f '{{join .Imports " "}}' ./cmd/morphd) || exit 1; for i in $I; do case $i in bufio|context|crypto/rand|encoding/hex|errors|flag|fmt|log|net/http|os|path/filepath|strconv|strings|time|morphstudio/stream|morphstudio/runner|morphstudio/queue|morphstudio/eventlog|morphstudio/telegram|morphstudio/github|morphstudio/claude|morphstudio/session|morphstudio/bootstrap|morphstudio/registry|morphstudio/gitrules|morphstudio/control|morphstudio/supervisor|morphstudio/api|morphstudio/mcpserver|morphstudio/daemon) ;; *) echo "imports: package cmd/morphd imports $i (allowed: bufio, context, crypto/rand, encoding/hex, errors, flag, fmt, log, net/http, os, path/filepath, strconv, strings, time, morphstudio/stream, morphstudio/runner, morphstudio/queue, morphstudio/eventlog, morphstudio/telegram, morphstudio/github, morphstudio/claude, morphstudio/session, morphstudio/bootstrap, morphstudio/registry, morphstudio/gitrules, morphstudio/control, morphstudio/supervisor, morphstudio/api, morphstudio/mcpserver, morphstudio/daemon)"; exit 1;; esac; done
echo '== listen'; C=$(gofmt -l -r 'http.ListenAndServe -> http.NoBody' cmd/morphd/main.go 2>&1); [ -n "$C" ] || { echo "listen: cmd/morphd/main.go never calls http.ListenAndServe (the record: one listener on 127.0.0.1)"; exit 1; }; grep -q '"127.0.0.1:"' cmd/morphd/main.go || { echo 'listen: cmd/morphd/main.go has no "127.0.0.1:" address literal (morphd listens on 127.0.0.1 only)'; exit 1; }
